items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: How did this offer to come and work for Benny come about? ... John Hammond. ... so they offered and I made a decision and I went.

ctx.x: If you're talking about anti-intellectualism, you had the time when the Hollywood Ten was getting summoned before the House on Unamerican Activities Committee and a lot of artists and actors and actresses were really, I guess, intimidated.

They were; I remember that period of time, very well. But I think the critics had been pushing this sort of thing for at least twenty years before that. John Hammond certainly is one, and I'm not negating John's purposes; I think they're fine. This is now why I'm talking like this, not at all.

I'm well aware of the debts we owe other people, but I also tend, for one reason, why should I deny my own heritage or you yours; you shouldn't, it's wrong to do that. You become something of a dilettante
